verdict.rationale: The fraud guide documents a split of responsibilities: Stripe runs automatic risk controls within Treasury without action needed, and platforms build and operate their own controls over onboarding, money movement, received credits, returns and negative balances. The prebuilt components also claim to avoid compliance reviews. That gives a glancing basis for transaction-level monitoring and a Stripe/platform division of duties, but it is framed as fraud control rather than AML compliance tooling. missing for 10: sanctions screening, alert case management, SAR-filing support, explicit bank (sponsor) role in the duty split, AML-specific transaction monitoring docs, independent corroboration.
